description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy- Determination of Customs Value (Price) for Motor Vehicles
reasoning: This gazette notification contains a regulation issued under the Customs Ordinance that amends how customs value is calculated for motor vehicles. It establishes a legal/regulatory framework for customs valuation procedures, specifically modifying existing regulations under statutory authority (Section 101 of the Customs Ordinance). The content focuses entirely on regulatory amendments rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
